content:
Of course. Here is a comprehensive set of facts about Aristotle, presented as (Subject, Predicate, Object) triples. The subject is almost always "Aristotle" to fit the query.

### Biography and Personal Life
*   (Aristotle, was born in, Stagira)
*   (Aristotle, was born in year, 384 BCE)
*   (Aristotle, died in, Chalcis)
*   (Aristotle, died in year, 322 BCE)
*   (Aristotle, had father named, Nicomachus)
*   (Nicomachus, had occupation, physician to King Amyntas III of Macedon)
*   (Aristotle, had wife named, Pythias)
*   (Aristotle, had daughter named, Pythias)
*   (Aristotle, after Pythias's death, had companion named, Herpyllis)
*   (Aristotle, had son with Herpyllis named, Nicomachus)

### Education and School
*   (Aristotle, moved to, Athens)
*   (Aristotle, joined, Plato's Academy)
*   (Aristotle, was a student of, Plato)
*   (Aristotle, remained at the Academy for, twenty years)
*   (Aristotle, founded his own school, the Lyceum)
*   (The Lyceum, was located in, Athens)
*   (Aristotle's philosophy, is also known as, the Peripatetic school)
*   (The term "Peripatetic", derives from, the 'peripatoi' or colonnades of the Lyceum)

### Relationships and Legacy
*   (Aristotle, was a critic of, Plato's Theory of Forms)
*   (Aristotle, was the tutor of, Alexander the Great)
*   (Aristotle's philosophy, is known as, Aristotelianism)
*   (Aristotle, heavily influenced, Western thought)
*   (Aristotle, heavily influenced, Islamic philosophy)
*   (Islamic philosophers, referred to Aristotle as, "The First Teacher")
*   (Aristotle, heavily influenced, Saint Thomas Aquinas)
*   (Aristotle, heavily influenced, Christian Scholasticism)
*   (Aristotle's writings, were preserved and translated by, Arabic scholars)

### Philosophy: Metaphysics
*   (Aristotle, wrote on, Metaphysics)
*   (Aristotle, considered Metaphysics, "first philosophy")
*   (Aristotle, analyzed, being qua being)
*   (Aristotle, proposed the concept of, substance)
*   (Aristotle, defined substance as a composite of, form and matter)
*   (Aristotle, theorized, hylomorphism)
*   (Aristotle, proposed, the Four Causes)
*   (The Four Causes, includes, the Material Cause)
*   (The Four Causes, includes, the Formal Cause)
*   (The Four Causes, includes, the Efficient Cause)
*   (The Four Causes, includes, the Final Cause)
*   (Aristotle, posited the existence of, a Prime Mover)
*   (The Prime Mover, is also called, the Unmoved Mover)

### Philosophy: Ethics
*   (Aristotle, authored, the Nicomachean Ethics)
*   (Aristotle, developed, virtue ethics)
*   (Aristotle, identified the highest good as, Eudaimonia)
*   (Eudaimonia, is translated as, "human flourishing" or "living well")
*   (Aristotle, proposed the doctrine of, the Golden Mean)
*   (The Golden Mean, describes virtue as, a mean between two vices of excess and deficiency)
*   (Aristotle, stated courage is the mean between, cowardice and recklessness)

### Philosophy: Logic
*   (Aristotle, is regarded as, the "father of logic")
*   (Aristotle, developed, the system of syllogistic logic)
*   (Aristotle, wrote, the Organon)
*   (The Organon, is, a set of six works on logic)
*   (Aristotle, introduced, the ten Categories of being)
*   (Aristotle, distinguished between, deductive and inductive reasoning)

### Philosophy: Politics
*   (Aristotle, authored, the work "Politics")
*   (Aristotle, defined man as, a "political animal" (zoon politikon))
*   (Aristotle, stated the natural end for humans is, the polis or city-state)
*   (Aristotle, collected and analyzed, the constitutions of 158 Greek city-states)
*   (Aristotle, classified governments based on, who rules and in whose interest)
*   (Aristotle, identified three correct forms of government, monarchy, aristocracy, and polity)
*   (Aristotle, identified three deviant forms of government, tyranny, oligarchy, and democracy)

### Natural Science and Biology
*   (Aristotle, was, a pioneering biologist)
*   (Aristotle, performed, empirical observation of the natural world)
*   (Aristotle, dissected, animals)
*   (Aristotle, classified, over 500 species of animals)
*   (Aristotle, wrote, "History of Animals")
*   (Aristotle, proposed, a geocentric model of the universe)
*   (Aristotle, believed the world was composed of, five classic elements (earth, water, air, fire, aether))

### Poetics and Rhetoric
*   (Aristotle, authored, the "Poetics")
*   (Aristotle, analyzed the components of, tragedy)
*   (Aristotle, defined tragedy as, an imitation of an action)
*   (Aristotle, proposed the concept of, catharsis)
*   (Aristotle, authored, the "Rhetoric")
*   (Aristotle, defined rhetoric as, the faculty of observing the available means of persuasion)
*   (Aristotle, identified three modes of persuasion, Ethos, Pathos, and Logos)

### Major Works
*   (Aristotle, authored, Nicomachean Ethics)
*   (Aristotle, authored, Politics)
*   (Aristotle, authored, Metaphysics)
*   (Aristotle, authored, Poetics)
*   (Aristotle, authored, On the Soul)
*   (Aristotle, authored, Rhetoric)
*   (Aristotle, authored, History of Animals)
*   (Aristotle, authored, Prior Analytics and Posterior Analytics (part of the Organon))
*   (Aristotle, authored, Physics)
